themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: Chips had their worst day since March 2020 on Nov 5 as the data center selloff spread from power to semis (CNBC). Nvidia fell 9.26% to 181.60, AMD 17.26%, Micron 17.46%, Broadcom 10.43%, Arm 13.08%, the TSMC ADR 10.78% and Astera Labs 19.62% even after Q3 revenue rose 154% (Massive). A TTM Technologies director bought about $632,000 at $63.15 on Nov 5, after he and the CEO bought near $88 to $90 on Oct 28 (dashboard).
themes.for_you: No chip swings or puts until a base forms on lighter volume. NVDA and AMD are now under their buy zones and fail the chart checks, so they are watch names. TTMI's insider cluster is the one smart money signal in the chain; watch the 58.94 low.

themes.name: AI power and the grid
themes.what: Vistra reported Nov 6: adjusted EBITDA $2.378 billion, up more than 50%, 2026 guidance narrowed to $7.1 to $7.5 billion, first 2027 guidance of $7.7 to $8.5 billion, a $1.5 billion buyback and a new 20 year, 207 MW power deal at its Odessa, Texas plant (SEC 8-K); shares rose about 5% premarket (Investing.com). The day before, the group fell again: Vertiv 14.02%, Quanta 12.30%, Bloom 16.41%, GE Vernova 7.48% and Vistra 6.15% (Massive).
themes.for_you: The first report since the election shows a Texas power producer still signing data center deals and raising its outlook. That is a reason to watch for a base, not to buy a two day 20% drop. No swings or puts in the group yet.

themes.name: Critical materials and geopolitics
themes.what: MP Materials reported Q3 on Nov 5: revenue $147.7 million, up 176%; NdPr output 1,018 tonnes, up 41%; GM magnet qualification complete, with paid magnet deliveries starting in Q4 (SEC 8-K). MP closed 33.74 (-6.04%) in the market rout and rose about 2.6% after hours (Benzinga, Massive). No notice extending China's rare earth export pause, which ends Nov 10, was found as of Nov 6.
themes.for_you: No action. MP has no setup or buy verdict. Nov 10 is the date to watch: a lapse in China's pause would make US magnet supply worth more.

themes.name: Fintech and Crypto Rails: Stablecoins, Tokenization, Exchanges
themes.what: Affirm's fiscal Q1 GMV rose 34% to $14.4 billion and it raised its full year GMV outlook to more than $65.25 billion, but the stock fell about 9% after hours to about 63.43 (Benzinga). Galaxy CEO Michael Novogratz bought about $9.86 million at $12.98 on Nov 5 (dashboard). Remitly fell 20.44% to 21.545 on Nov 5 a day after it beat and raised; the reason was not found. Coinbase fell 9.69% and Robinhood 10.32% (Massive).
themes.for_you: No AFRM put: the after hours price is under its 64.54 zone bottom and the group is falling. GLXY's CEO buy is watch only; no setup.

innovations.name: Space
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Starship Flight 15 is listed no earlier than Nov 8 on an FAA planning schedule and will try to catch both the booster and the ship; SpaceX has not set a firm date (Basenor). Rocket Lab reports Q3 on Nov 9 after the close (company). In the Nov 5 rout SpaceX fell 9.05% to 123.62, Rocket Lab 12.18% to 45.99, AST SpaceMobile 15.22% and Planet 10.12% (Massive), while ARK bought SPCX and RKLB (ARK trade email).
innovations.for_you: No action; none are on the swing or put lists. Stage stays early adoption: no catch or refueling yet. Flight 15 and RKLB's Nov 9 report are the next facts; the selloff, not space news, moved these stocks this week.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: Brent rose 3.88% to settle at $98.29 on Nov 5 after Iran's Revolutionary Guard said two tankers and a tugboat caught fire trying unauthorized routes through Hormuz (Reuters). Reuters also reported Iran sent a nuclear proposal to Washington through Qatar; Rapidan puts the chance of renewed fighting at 80% (CNBC). XLE still fell 2.98% (Massive).
countries.for_you: No oil swings; the four oil plans closed by the stop rule on Nov 4. Energy stocks fell on a day oil rose, so wait for a fresh dashboard setup.

countries.name: South Korea
countries.what: The KOSPI fell 6.02% to 5,059.69 on Nov 6 after a Level 1 circuit breaker at 9:03am Seoul time (about 7:03pm ET Nov 5); SK hynix fell 10.44% to 1.132 million won and Samsung 6.35% to 188,700 won (Korea Herald, IBTimes). In New York on Nov 5, EWY fell 13.46% to 131.65 (Massive).
countries.for_you: No Korea or memory trades; two days of 5% to 6% drops with a halt is forced selling. Wait for a base.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.what: In the Nov 5 US chip rout the TSMC ADR fell 10.78% to 353.10, UMC 16.69% and EWT 11.54% to 85.88 (Massive); the Taiex close for Nov 6 was not found.
countries.for_you: No action. TSM has no buy verdict; wait for the selling to slow before looking.
